senses.gloss: f. (Pales of סְלֵק, by false etymology of מוּגְמָר q. v.) a fragrant plant used after meals in place of burnt spices.
units: <cite ref="Shabbat 50b:15">Sabb. 50ᵇ</cite> ed. (Ms. M. <cite ref="O00996"><he>סְלִיקוּתָא</he></cite>, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note; Ar. Var. <cite ref="H01064"><he>חֲלִיקוּסְתָּא</he></cite>, v. <cite ref="O00995">next w.</cite>).
